Giving back to the community, society and country in various ways is part of Vedanta’s larger purpose. We are committed to work for greater good towards national prosperity and sustainable growth.

title: Part-Time Faculty – Data Science & Data Analytics
description: Part-Time Faculty – Data Science & Data Analytics Company: Gtech Computer Institute Location: Puttur, Karnataka Job Type: Part-Time Salary: ₹10,000 – ₹20,000 per month (Negotiable, based on experience) Job Description Gtech Computer Institute, Puttur, is looking for experienced and passionate part-time faculty members to teach Data Science and Data Analytics courses. We are looking for professionals who can deliver practical, industry-oriented training and help students develop the skills required for careers in data science and analytics. Responsibilities Conduct classroom and practical training sessions in Data Science and Data Analytics. Teach Python, SQL, Excel, Power BI and other relevant tools. Explain statistical concepts, data visualization and data analysis techniques. Provide hands-on training using real-world datasets and industry-based projects. Guide students in completing practical assignments and projects. Prepare students for interviews and entry-level industry opportunities. Required Skills Strong knowledge of Data Science or Data Analytics. Proficiency in Python, SQL, Excel and Power BI. Experience in handling practical projects and real-world datasets. Good communication and presentation skills. Ability to teach students with different levels of technical knowledge. Eligibility Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics or a related field. Previous teaching or industry experience is preferred. Experienced industry professionals and freelancers interested in part-time teaching are welcome to apply. Work Schedule Part-time engagement with flexible class timings, based on batch schedules and faculty availability. How to Apply Interested candidates can apply through Indeed with their updated resume, teaching experience and expected salary. Join Gtech Computer Institute and help students build their careers in Data Science and Data Analytics. Pay: ₹400.00 - ₹700.00 per hour Expected hours: 7.0 per week Benefits: Flexible schedule Work Location: In person
